title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02310:20101213:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Rules on Subject-Matter Jurisdiction of Civil and Family Litigation) <No. 2310, December 13, 2010>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on January 1, 2011.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Rules) Part of the Rules on Handling Affairs of Divisions of High Courts at Locations of District Courts shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1), "Article 28 of the Court Organization Act and Article 4 of the Rules on Subject-Matter Jurisdiction of Civil and Family Litigation" shall be replaced with "Article 28 of the Court Organization Act."
